dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular and fragmented off-white perimeters forming prominent 'O' and 'C' shapes; edges are jagged with a sharp gradient transition from the dark grey exterior to a light grey/white interior outline.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of localized, asymmetrical light-intensity pixel clusters concentrated primarily along the dorsal ridge and moving towards the anterior-lateral region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent macro-annuli form an irregular quadrilateral spanning from the mid-dorsal ridge down towards the mid-flank and anteriorly towards the neck.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense, interlocking series of small annuli located on the lateral-cervical region, creating a distinctive chain-link visual pattern.
